masked.role: informational only (v4.1): lf_inputs NaN'd on weak rows at train time; eval rows unmasked — the train/test mismatch is real and disclosed, no gate rides on this variant
masked.train_test_mismatch: weak-row lf_inputs masked during training folds; validation-fold and dev-gold rows are unmasked, mirroring deployment

best.role: accuracy-oriented: static + warnings + source semantics; G8 still rides on full

execution.role: needs a run record: code + warnings + execution evidence + repair evidence; abstains when they are absent, because it was not trained without them

g8.note: caps recorded, not silently enforced — a violation is a finding for the team, per §8 Layer-3
